title: Prefix sum of paired products
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number, let $w$ be a Boolean vector of length $2m$, and let $k$ be a natural number. The prefix bit is the sum in $\mathbb{F}_2$ of the paired coordinate products at indices $i<k$ that also satisfy $i<m$.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a Boolean vector of length $2m$
